shared_elements: incised linear/geometric marks arranged in rows or bands
justification: Both show eroded relief carving on grey stone including at least one frontal standing anthropomorphic figure and rows of shallow incised marks, but that is a very generic correspondence. A is a single freestanding, rounded monolith whose whole body is one figure with a large disc motif at its centre, while B is a broad flat rock face dominated by faint linear inscription panels with tiny figures relegated to niches at the base — different scale, format and carving depth entirely.
